themes.name: [Negative] Poor Customer Service

quotes.text: Even customer support does not respond properly.
Haven’t seen any company with such low customer centricity.
Very disappointing service.
Customer support is very bad , so do not fall for this company it's a trap.
It is completely unacceptable that a platform handling people's hard-earned money and investments makes it virtually impossible to speak with a human being.

themes.description: Customer experience involves dealing with long response times, unresponsive or non-existent customer support, unhelpful chatbots, and difficulty in initiating a support conversation or resolving actual user issues.
themes.business_impact: Negative customer experience results in low customer satisfaction, decreased trust in the brand, and ultimately, high churn risk.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Insufficient human customer support teams, over-reliance on AI chatbots, and a lack of process in handling customer support requests may be contributing factors.
themes.action_plan: • Establish dedicated human customer support teams for critical customer issues, revamp the chatbot system to better handle complex conversations, and set up processes to track and resolve customer support requests promptly|Develop customer support training programs for the team|Regularly assess and improve customer satisfaction metrics.

themes.name: [Negative] Broken Cashback System

quotes.text: cashback points are not usable for recharge please fix this :(
cashback only used to buy US stocks. not applying on Bill payments.
They provide cashback as a trap...one day sudden I'm unable to use cashback... Fraud people are they ....

I diverted most of my bills and Upi payments to this app for cashback, now all of a sudden the cashback amount cannot be used to pay for recharges or other bill payments anymore and it can only be used for US Stocks...
Now cashback is not using in recharge and bill payment, so I am uninstalled this app

themes.description: Users are unable to use their earned cashback points to recharge or pay bills, and can only use it for stock purchases, leading to frustration and disappointment.
themes.business_impact: High churn risk due to loss of trust in the app's reward system, and potential revenue loss from users uninstalling the app.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The cashback system has been changed to prioritize stock trading over bill payments, causing user confusion and frustration.
themes.action_plan: • Re-evaluate and reverse the changes to the cashback system to allow users to use their points to recharge and pay bills, and provide clear communication to users about the changes.

themes.name: [Negative] App Crashes and Performance Issues

quotes.text: very bad
shity platform. Don't use it. useless
The app is not opening at all whenever I open the app it keep exiting on its own
worst experience
horrible experience after the last update.
very slow app with poor internet buffering

themes.description: Users are experiencing frequent app crashes, slow app performance, and issues with internet buffering, leading to frustrating user experience. Some users also experienced difficulties with adding money to the app, further highlighting system instability.
themes.business_impact: The recurring app crashes and performance issues are likely to lead to high user dissatisfaction, negative word-of-mouth, and ultimately, app uninstallation. This theme may also be correlated with increased support requests and decreased user engagement.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The root cause of these issues may be related to poor code quality, incompatibility with existing device configurations, or insufficient testing of new features. These bugs might have been introduced during recent updates, highlighting the need for more rigorous testing and debugging.
themes.action_plan: • Conduct a comprehensive code review to identify and fix critical bugs. Develop and implement a revised testing framework to ensure seamless compatibility with various device configurations and prevent future regressions. Deploy incremental updates with isolated feature rollouts to minimize the risk of app crashes and performance degradation.
